## identify the negatives

```{r}


# Start with very strict criteria
identified_negatives <- merged_input %>%
  filter(label == 0) %>%
  filter(rt_similarity < 0.4,
         EIC_similarity < 0.4,
         cor_value < 0.4)

```




## check any positive labels has low values
```{r}


check_pos_val <- merged_input %>%
  filter(label == 1) %>%
  filter(
    rt_similarity < 0.7 |
      EIC_similarity < 0.7 |
      cor_value < 0.6
  ) %>%  arrange(feature_1_rt) %>% 
  data.frame()

check_pos_val
```
```{r}
check_strong_pos_val <- merged_input %>%
  filter(label == 1) %>%
  filter(
    rt_similarity > 0.7 &
      EIC_similarity > 0.7 |
      
      cor_value >0.7
  ) %>%  data.frame()

check_strong_pos_val
```



### check eic

```{r}
#######################################################
# multi features EIC plot in one
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


plot_multiple_EICs <- function(all_EIC_list, feature_indices) {
  
  combined_df <- lapply(feature_indices, function(i) {
    df <- all_EIC_list[[i]]$EIC_df
    df$sample <- rownames(df)              # rownames -> sample column
    df$feature <- paste0("Feature ", i)    # tag which feature it is
    df
  }) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    filter(!is.na(intensity) & intensity > 0)
  
  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(
    x = rt,
    y = log10(intensity),  #intensity,  # log10(intensity),
    color = feature,
    group = feature      # connect points for each feature
  )) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 1) +                 # add points to see each dot
    labs(
      title = paste("Overlayed EICs for Features", paste(feature_indices, collapse = ", ")),
      x = "Retention Time (rt)",
      y = "log10(Intensity)",
      color = "Feature"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  p
}

```


```{r}
plot_multiple_EICs(all_EIC_list = eic_obj@parsed_EIC, feature_indices = c(245,330))
```
```{r}
plot_multiple_EICs(all_EIC_list = eic_obj@parsed_EIC, feature_indices = c(805,637))
```
